patches.summary: Added invoices download-pdf using the Partitaiva24 SPA's bundled jsPDF renderer.
patches.reason: The official web UI renders invoice PDFs entirely client-side, so matching Scarica PDF requires running the extracted SPA renderer rather than calling an API endpoint.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./... passed; rendered /tmp/p24-test.pdf as a one-page A4 PDF with Producer jsPDF 2.5.2.
